sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
sprinkler.desc: Place it on the farm (hold it, USE on open ground). Waters the 4 tiles beside it every morning. USE it again to pick it up.

chest.name: Chest
chest.desc: Place it on the farm (hold it, USE on open ground). Holds 24 stacks. Open it with A; pick it up from its screen once it's empty.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: Place it on the farm. Keeps crows off crops within 8 tiles.

honey.name: Honey
honey.desc: From your beehives, or found in the Meadow.

strawberry_wine.name: Strawberry Wine
strawberry_wine.desc: Sweet strawberries, kegged and aged. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

corn_ale.name: Corn Ale
corn_ale.desc: Brewed from the farm's corn. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

truffle.name: Truffle
truffle.desc: Dug up by happy pigs, or found in old forests.

thug_cash.name: Rolled Bills
thug_cash.desc: Real cash off the President's thugs. Unmarked, safe to sell at the box. Sal has a use for it.

sprinkler_quality.name: Quality Sprinkler
sprinkler_quality.desc: Waters the 8 tiles around it every morning.

sprinkler_iridium.name: Iridium Sprinkler
sprinkler_iridium.desc: Waters a 5x5 square around it every morning.

moon_shard.name: Moon Shard
moon_shard.desc: A sliver of the moon's crystal. Found only up there.

pelt.name: Shed Fur
pelt.desc: Combed from the brambles where a moulting coat brushed past; no animal is hurt. Rook buys these; tailors want them.

meat.name: Trail Rations
meat.desc: Smoked beans and grain cake, packed for the hills. Cook it for more.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.desc: Rook's fletching. For the bow, when there is one.

flour.name: Flour
flour.desc: Milled at the lake. Posy pays well for it.

wine.name: Wine
wine.desc: From the keg. Sells well at the fair. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

candy.name: Candy
candy.desc: The kids will do anything for this.

old_coin.name: Old Coin
old_coin.desc: Dug up somewhere it shouldn't have been.

fossil.name: Fossil
fossil.desc: A fish from before the lake.

hay.name: Hay
hay.desc: Animal feed. Scythe tall grass, grow wheat, bale fiber at the Mill, or buy it from Maple or Tam.

bone.name: Old Antler
bone.desc: Shed every spring and found in the grass. The dog approves.

glow_cap.name: Glow Cap
glow_cap.desc: A mushroom that lights the night.

starflower.name: Starflower
starflower.desc: Only grows where the crystal fell.

trap.name: Bramble Brush
trap.desc: Rook's design. Set by the trails, it combs shed fur from passing coats; nothing is caught.

heart_fruit.name: Heart Fruit
heart_fruit.desc: Grows on the oldest trees. +10 max health, forever.

stamina_root.name: Stamina Root
stamina_root.desc: Dug from the hills. +10 max energy, forever.

sheep_wool.name: Wool
sheep_wool.desc: Shorn from a happy sheep or llama. Spin it into yarn at the Loom.

honeycomb.name: Honeycomb
honeycomb.desc: Straight from the hive. Spin it at the Honey Extractor for honey and beeswax.

cider.name: Cider
cider.desc: Pressed apples, kegged till they fizz. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

old_collar.name: Old Collar
old_collar.desc: Leather, chewed, a brass tag worn smooth. BISCUIT.

brass_locket.name: Brass Locket
brass_locket.desc: Two boys on a dock. It hums near crystals.

knight_shard.name: Knight's Shard
knight_shard.desc: Warm, heavy. Your sword hand stops aching.

manifest.name: Shipping Manifest
manifest.desc: Every crate marked with a purple crystal. UPTOWN, TOWER, SUB-BASEMENT 3.

litter_box.name: Litter Box
litter_box.desc: Cat-topia's secret weapon. Throw it: every Grump nearby stops to hold its nose.

finargle_fuzz.name: Finargle Fuzz
finargle_fuzz.desc: Black and warm and it hums faintly in your pack. Spies' leavings.

sacred_key.name: Sacred Key
sacred_key.desc: A keepsake from the crystal babies. Coldy says it once opened the heart of Mount Prismatica. It is warm, and it is humming.

merkitty_necklace.name: Merkitty Necklace
merkitty_necklace.desc: Glows blue-green in the dark. You grow a tail the moment you touch water.

fruit_wine.name: Fruit Wine
fruit_wine.desc: Whatever the orchard gave, given time. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

fine_wine.name: Fine Wine
fine_wine.desc: Alder keeps one bottle back for the fair display. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

starlight_wine.name: Starlight Wine
starlight_wine.desc: It glows a little in the glass. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

pickles.name: Pickles
pickles.desc: A jar of the garden, for winter.

herbal_tea.name: Herbal Tea
herbal_tea.desc: Steeped in the keg. Wren approves.

harvest_ale.name: Harvest Ale
harvest_ale.desc: Grain, water, patience. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

flower_mead.name: Flower Mead
flower_mead.desc: Smells like the meadow in June. A trade good: sold and gifted, never drunk.

wonder_elixir.name: Wonder Elixir
wonder_elixir.desc: Brewed from a crop that should not exist.

chili_pot.name: Pot of Chili
chili_pot.desc: Rook says it needs more pepper. Rook is wrong.

chocolate.name: Chocolate
chocolate.desc: From your own cacao. Pip will follow you anywhere now.

wishfruit_cake.name: Wishfruit Cake
wishfruit_cake.desc: Make a wish before the first bite.

seed_packet.name: Wild Seed Packet
seed_packet.desc: Open it: a seed of something in season. You never know which.

yarn.name: Yarn
yarn.desc: Soft and warm. Spun from wool or rabbit fur at the Loom.

hearth_brew.name: Hearth Brew
hearth_brew.desc: Warm to the toes. Snow and cold water bother you less.

growth_elixir.name: Growth Elixir
growth_elixir.desc: Pour it out: every crop on your farm grows a day.

scooter.name: Kick Scooter
scooter.desc: Hold it and press USE to ride. Faster than walking; no tools while riding.

rowboat.name: Rowboat
rowboat.desc: Hold it and press USE at the water: row instead of swimming, fast and dry.

motor_scooter.name: Motor Scooter
motor_scooter.desc: Twice as fast as your feet.

balloon.name: Hot-Air Balloon
balloon.desc: Hold it and press USE outdoors: drift to any place you have already visited.

crystal_sled.name: Crystal Sled
crystal_sled.desc: Fast anywhere; faster in winter and on the mountain.

getaway_car.name: Getaway Car
getaway_car.desc: Black, quiet, quick. Nobody saw you leave.

bills_crude.name: Crude Bills
bills_crude.desc: Hold and USE in a town to pass them for ◆70. About 1 in 3 gets noticed.

bills_passable.name: Passable Bills
bills_passable.desc: Pass for ◆150. About 1 in 6 gets noticed.

bills_fine.name: Fine Bills
bills_fine.desc: Pass for ◆320. About 1 in 11 gets noticed.

bills_perfect.name: Perfect Bills
bills_perfect.desc: Pass for ◆700. Even the bank blinks.

forged_permit.name: Forged Permit
forged_permit.desc: USE it at home: your next building permit is "already stamped". 1 in 4 gets noticed.

fedora.name: Fedora
fedora.desc: A sharp felt hat. Every crew boss has one.

shades.name: Shades
shades.desc: Dark lenses for bright neon nights.

pinstripe_suit.name: Pinstripe Suit
pinstripe_suit.desc: A sharp suit with a little padding sewn in.

armored_suit.name: Armored Suit
armored_suit.desc: Looks like a suit, stops like a wall.

steel_toes.name: Steel-Toe Shoes
steel_toes.desc: Kick a crate, keep your toes.

knuckle_gloves.name: Knuckle Gloves
knuckle_gloves.desc: Leather gloves with a hard knuckle.

trench_coat.name: Trench Coat
trench_coat.desc: Long coat, deep pockets, quick feet.

tool_belt.name: Driver's Belt
tool_belt.desc: A driver's belt: tools close, hands free.

hot_cocoa.name: Hot Cocoa
hot_cocoa.desc: Big Jim makes it too sweet. Warm for hours.

scented_litter.name: Scented Litter Box
scented_litter.desc: Lavender. Somehow worse. A wider cloud, a longer nose-hold.

mega_litter.name: Mega Litter Box
mega_litter.desc: The catapult-sized one. Clears a room.

tuna_treat.name: Tuna Treat
tuna_treat.desc: Every cat in Cat-topia wants one. So does your pup.

paw_lantern.name: Paw Lantern
paw_lantern.desc: A little jar of Meow Pow Wow light. Open it for luck and mana.

heart_spark.name: Heart Spark
heart_spark.desc: A rainbow heart in a bottle. Mana and health at once.

snow_goggles.name: Snow Goggles
snow_goggles.desc: Keeps the glare and the snow out.

crystal_parka.name: Crystal Parka
crystal_parka.desc: A parka laced with crystal threads.

starlight_mantle.name: Starlight Mantle
starlight_mantle.desc: Woven from moonweave. It glows a little.

mitten_paws.name: Mitten Paws
mitten_paws.desc: Cosy mittens with a firm grip.

courage_scarf.name: Scarf of Courage
courage_scarf.desc: A scarf that makes you stand taller.

flipper_belt.name: Flipper Belt
flipper_belt.desc: A belt with a little paddle flair.

scrambler.name: Signal Scrambler
scrambler.desc: USE it: your face drops off two wanted lists. Heat -2.

ghost_ledger.name: Ghost Ledger
ghost_ledger.desc: USE it: you were never here. Heat to zero.

emp_charge.name: EMP Charge
emp_charge.desc: USE it: everything near you locks up for 4 seconds, and any Gift stutters OPEN for 3.

emp_heavy.name: Blackout Charge
emp_heavy.desc: A whole block goes dark. Gifts stutter open for 5 seconds.

spy_drone.name: Spy Drone
spy_drone.desc: USE it (kept; recharges for 2 days): it circles and reports who is here, how to beat anyone with a Gift, and keeps collectors off you for the day.

scrap_bot.name: Scrap Bot
scrap_bot.desc: USE it: a little bot plants itself and zaps anything hostile for 30 seconds.

guard_bot.name: Guard Bot
guard_bot.desc: A bigger bot. A minute of cover.

drone_swarm.name: Drone Swarm
drone_swarm.desc: Six drones, 45 seconds, no mercy for furniture.

optic_implant.name: Optic Implant
optic_implant.desc: One eye glows a little. You see the tell before the swing.

reflex_wires.name: Reflex Wires
reflex_wires.desc: Your hands arrive before you decide.

chrome_arm.name: Chrome Arm
chrome_arm.desc: It hums. Handshakes are shorter now.

colony_light.name: Colony Light
colony_light.desc: The steady glow of a saved colony's star crystal. The Aurora Dome of the Crystal Ward wants four.

coral_charm.name: Coral Charm
coral_charm.desc: Grown, not carved. Warm in your hand.

tide_pearl.name: Tide Pearl
tide_pearl.desc: You can hear the sea in it.

ember_glass.name: Ember Glass
ember_glass.desc: Glass made in a volcano by a very patient cat.

backpack_1.name: Bigger Backpack
backpack_1.desc: Adds 12 bag slots for different items. Used the moment you buy it.

backpack_2.name: Traveller's Pack
backpack_2.desc: Adds 12 bag slots for different items. Used the moment you buy it.

backpack_3.name: Bottomless Pack
backpack_3.desc: Adds 12 bag slots for different items. Used the moment you buy it.

commons_stew.name: Community Stew
commons_stew.desc: Whatever came up first in the community beds, simmered all afternoon.

harvest_cobbler.name: Harvest Cobbler
harvest_cobbler.desc: Hazel's cobbler: orchard fruit under a golden crust. Feels lucky.

harvest_basket.name: Harvest Basket
harvest_basket.desc: A basket of the community farm's best. Everybody loves one.

green_thumb_charm.name: Green Thumb Charm
green_thumb_charm.desc: Carved from the garden's first orchard prune. A gift from everyone who helped.

rp_fizzy_pop.name: Fizzy Pop
rp_fizzy_pop.desc: From the vending machine at the rec. Fizzes up your nose.

rp_cotton_candy.name: Cotton Candy
rp_cotton_candy.desc: Pure sugar cloud. A spring in your step for an hour.

rp_ribbon.name: Lucky Ribbon
rp_ribbon.desc: A prize-counter ribbon. Nice to give.

rp_kite.name: Kite
rp_kite.desc: Diamond kite with a long tail. The kids would love it.

rp_teddy.name: Teddy Bear
rp_teddy.desc: The prize every kid points at first.

rp_cat_plush.name: Lucky Cat
rp_cat_plush.desc: Waves one paw forever. For luck.

rp_bowling_cap.name: Bowling Cap
rp_bowling_cap.desc: League cap from the lanes at the rec.

rp_top_hat.name: Top Hat
rp_top_hat.desc: For the sharpest bowler on the lanes.

rp_star_cape.name: Star Cape
rp_star_cape.desc: Only bowlers who've rolled a 200 wear this.

rp_music_box.name: Music Box
rp_music_box.desc: Decor: it sits in your house and plays a little tune.

rp_trophy_gold.name: Gold Bowling Trophy
rp_trophy_gold.desc: Decor: for a 220 game. The house record wall knows your name.

rp_golden_pin.name: Golden Pin
rp_golden_pin.desc: Decor: for a 270 game. People will ask.

rp_arcade_medal.name: Arcade Medal
rp_arcade_medal.desc: Decor: for playing every cabinet in the hall.

rp_jukebox.name: Jukebox
rp_jukebox.desc: Decor: a real jukebox for your house.

rp_arcade_cab.name: Home Arcade Cabinet
rp_arcade_cab.desc: Decor: your own cabinet at home. It blinks all night.

wisp_thread.name: Wisp Thread
wisp_thread.desc: Spun by the glade wisps. Warm to the touch.

wisp_spark.name: Wisp Spark
wisp_spark.desc: A wisp's light, caught before it could fade.

luna_moth.name: Luna Moth
luna_moth.desc: Sleeps all day on the lantern posts of Lanternfall.

charm_root.name: Thornroot Charm
charm_root.desc: The Thornmother's last bud, closed tight.

sunstone.name: Sunstone
sunstone.desc: Holds the day's heat long after dark.

sun_scarab.name: Sun Scarab
sun_scarab.desc: A golden beetle carved by the temple builders.

charm_sun.name: Colossus Charm
charm_sun.desc: A chip of the Colossus's heart. Still warm.

pocket_watch.name: Baron's Pocket Watch
pocket_watch.desc: Runs eight minutes fast. Every train in Ironline ran by it.

frost.name: Rime Crystal
frost.desc: Ice that has forgotten how to melt.

charm_frost.name: Rimewyrm Charm
charm_frost.desc: One scale of the Rime Wyrm, frosted over for good.

storm_eye.name: Eye of the Storm
storm_eye.desc: Perfectly calm inside. Listen closely and it hums.

gambler_chip.name: Gilt Chip
gambler_chip.desc: A house chip from the Gilt casinos, gold-edged and heavy. Collectors pay well for them.

ring_platinum.name: Aurum Signet
ring_platinum.desc: Madame Aurum's seal. Doors open for whoever wears it.

rp_candy.name: Prize Candy
rp_candy.desc: A paper twist of prize-counter candy. Anyone with a sweet tooth loves it.

rp_sprout_fizz.name: Sprout Fizz
rp_sprout_fizz.desc: Prize-counter plant tonic: pour it out and every crop on your farm grows a day. One a week.

rp_fuzzy_dice.name: Fuzzy Dice
rp_fuzzy_dice.desc: A pair of fuzzy dice for a rear-view mirror. Every getaway car deserves some.

rp_lane_fedora.name: Pinstripe Fedora
rp_lane_fedora.desc: Only bowlers who've rolled a 150 at the Rec Hall wear the stripe. People make room.

rp_popcorn.name: Lucky Popcorn
rp_popcorn.desc: A striped bucket of buttery popcorn. Regulars swear it steadies your hand at the claw and the skee lanes.

rp_pretzel.name: Hot Pretzel
rp_pretzel.desc: Warm, salty, as big as your face. Bowling fuel.

ember_koi.name: Ember Koi
ember_koi.desc: Fire-gold scales. The Gilded Gardens' pond keeps it warm all winter.

sparkling_wine.name: Sparkling Wine
sparkling_wine.desc: A gold-foiled bottle from the Maison. For selling, gifting and fancy shelves, never for drinking.

bouquet.name: Bouquet

sea_locket.name: Sea-Glass Locket

curators_loupe.name: Curator's Loupe
